Network Title: Manitoba – Department of Natural Resources and Indigenous Futures, Fire Weather Network

Domain: Weather

Network Type: Atmospheric: Surface

Network Provider: Manitoba Department of Natural Resources and Indigenous Futures

Network Provider Website: https://www.gov.mb.ca/jec/index.html

Station Automation: Automated

Highest Sampling Frequency: Hourly

Data Feed Frequency: Real time

Period of Operation (Seasonal or Continuous): Continuous

Number of Stations: 42

Category of Reported Elements: Temperature; Humidity; Rainfall; Wind; Snow water equivalent* (*Only at 10 stations)

Data Access Points: 
https://www.gov.mb.ca/conservation_fire/Wx-Display/weatherview/weatherview.html
https://www.gov.mb.ca/conservation_fire/Wx-Display/weatherview/data/wx_last48.csv
https://www.gov.mb.ca/conservation_fire/Wx-Hour/currentwx.txt [The data currently includes other station networks.]

Quality Assessed (Yes/No): No

Legal Constraints: This is raw data that has undergone minimal quality control. There may be missing or erroneous data as a result of sensor malfunction, or routine maintenance. Use data at your own risk.
